messages:
sasha: Heads-up — PTQ ensemble canary for raven-lite-int8 is showing elevated funcall parse entropy. parse_failure_rate ~2.3% vs baseline 0.4% on non-PTQ base. Sampled failures attached below.

jamie: Whoa, that's a pretty big jump. Is this in prod canary or the onboard harness?

sasha: Onboard canary. Command we ran: `./evals/run_structured_call_canary.sh --model raven-lite-int8 --variants ensemble,base --n=5k`
Metrics we log: parse_failure_rate, schema_mismatch_entropy_bits, funcall_omit_rate.

mike: Can you paste an anonymized failing sample? Trailing comma / extra field / wrong type?

sasha: Sure — one of the failing outputs (redacted ids):
```
{"id":"r-1234","response":"OK","tool_call": [
  {"name": "get_user", "args": "{\"user\": \"alice\"}"} 
]
}
```
This one returned an array for tool_call instead of the expected object and sometimes omitted the `name` key entirely. Also some outputs are non-JSON suffixes like "\nThanks!" which trips strict parser.

oliver: Huh. The array/object flip could point to an ensemble gating issue where a quantized head emits a compact NDJSON-like stream. Any correlation with batch_size / kv-cache?

deepa: Telemetry shows spikes when batch_size >= 8 and seq_len > 512. Single-request replay doesn't always reproduce — suggests a batching or parallelism race.

sasha: Plan: 1) run a focused sweep: batch_size in [1,2,4,8] with seq_len buckets; 2) enable a strict-json wrapper in the canary to capture raw token stream + token offsets for failing requests; 3) temporarily disable ensemble fallback for raven-lite-int8 in the canary routing policy until we root cause. :warning:

jamie: SGTM. I'll add a short alert on the canary dashboard and flip the routing flag to off for the ensemble on that model. @triage-bot can you create an incident ticket if parse_failure_rate > 1% sustained for 5m?

triage-bot: Created ticket INF-1423: "raven-lite-int8 ensemble parse entropy" assigned to @sasha and @jamie — priority P2.

mike: Also request: dump logits + token boundary indices for 20 random failures so we can check whether quantization altered tokenization/merge behavior. Might be a subtoken fusion issue at int8.

sasha: Added to the runbook and pushed a small repro gist: https://gist.github.com/sasha/raven-ptq-ensemble-repro — will kick off the sweep now and post updates here.

jamie: Thanks. Keep the short samples coming, ideally 1-2 that reproduce locally. If we see batch-size sensitivity we can add an autoscale guard to keep batch sizes below the threshold for the canary. :thumbsup:
